set +e
export LANG=C.UTF-8
LOG=/tmp/vc_run_$(date +%s).log
{
  echo '===== [1] Check archivo ====='
  ls -la /tmp/vitalclinic.txt
  echo ''
  echo '===== [2] Run vitalclinic.py con stderr a stdout ====='
  cat /tmp/vitalclinic.txt | python3 /opt/scripts/droguerias/vitalclinic.py 2>&1
  echo ""
  echo "EXIT_CODE=$?"
  echo ''
  echo '===== [3] Filas y Ãºltima carga ====='
  PYTHONPATH=/opt/scripts/droguerias python3 -c "
from db_config import get_conn_str
import pyodbc
c = pyodbc.connect(get_conn_str())
cur = c.cursor()
cur.execute('SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(fecha_carga) FROM Proveedores.VitalClinic_Inventario')
r = cur.fetchone()
print(f'Filas: {r[0]} Ultima carga: {r[1]}')
cur.execute(\"SELECT TOP 2 ProviderID, LEFT(FileHash,16) AS h, ProcessedAt FROM dbo.InboundFilesLog WHERE ProviderID='vitalclinic' ORDER BY ProcessedAt DESC\")
for row in cur.fetchall():
    print(f'  Log: {row.ProviderID} | {row.h} | {row.ProcessedAt}')
c.close()
"
} > $LOG 2>&1
